description: This PHP source file defines a web interface for configuring and debugging VoIP service provider settings, including SIP logging server details and gain settings. It includes PHP PHP functions and server-side code, along with embedded HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the client-side UI.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Fetches current VoIP debug configurations such as receive/transmit gain, log server IP and port, and SIP process status.
